name: Firestar Internet
summary: Perth 'no frills' dialup and ADSL ISP (Firestar Internet Pty Ltd, ACN 059 181 958, formerly Mundijong Investments Pty Ltd); absorbed into Concept Networks (LetsGo) ~early 2004; company deregistered 2007.

events.details: Firestar Internet Pty Ltd (ACN 059 181 958, formerly Mundijong Investments Pty Ltd, incorporated 22 Feb 1993); ABN registered 1 Nov 1999; earliest Wayback capture Jul 2001; 'no frills' dialup and ADSL ISP.
Absorbed into Concept Networks (trading as LetsGo); firestar.com.au later redirected to letsgo.com.au (Aug 2006); company deregistered 27 May 2007.
